# cellxgene_summary_v

CZ CELLxGENE Discover human single-cell expression, pooled across every dataset that
measured the gene: one row per (gene, rolled-up cell type, tissue_general), normal tissue
only (disease PATO:0000461, tissue_type 'tissue', cell type 'unknown' left out; spatial
assays are left out unless the release was built with summary_include_spatial, off by
default), and broad lineage labels such as 'leukocyte' or 'epithelial cell' left out. Rank
cell types by the PRIMARY metrics mean_log1p_cp10k and frac_expressing.
donor_pseudobulk_mean_cp10k is SECONDARY: linear-scale CP10k, NULL when fewer than the
release's min_pseudobulk_donors (default 3) donors have a nonzero library, and it does not
rank anything. Rows below 50 cells or 3 donors (release defaults; the view applies each
release's min_cells/min_donors) are dropped, not shown as 0. Genes are GENCODE v49; chr uses
X=23, Y=24, MT=26. Always filter on chr: it is the partition column, and a query without it
scans the whole table. Per-dataset, per-disease detail is in cellxgene_expression_v.

## Scan pruning

Partitioned on `chr`: a literal `chr = <n>` predicate is what keeps a query under the sandbox's per-query scan cap, which BigQuery checks against its partition-pruned estimate before running anything. Clustered on `gene_name`, `gene_id`: an equality on these cuts the bytes actually billed but does not lower that estimate, so it never substitutes for the partition predicate.

## Columns

| column | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gene_id` | `STRING` | GENCODE v49 Ensembl gene ID, versioned (ENSG00000169442.9) |
| `chr` | `INT64` | Chromosome (X=23, Y=24, MT=26). Partition column — always filter on it |
| `gene_start` | `INT64` | Gene start (GRCh38) |
| `gene_end` | `INT64` | Gene end (GRCh38) |
| `gene_name` | `STRING` | GENCODE v49 gene symbol |
| `source_gene_ids` | `STRING` | Comma-separated Ensembl IDs as the source datasets spelled them |
| `cell_type_rollup_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | Rolled-up Cell Ontology term (CL:...) |
| `cell_type_rollup` | `STRING` | Rolled-up cell type label |
| `tissue_general_ontology_term_id` | `STRING` | UBERON tissue_general term |
| `tissue_general` | `STRING` | tissue_general label, e.g. lung, blood, liver |
| `n_cells` | `INT64` | Cells pooled over the datasets that measured the gene |
| `n_donors` | `INT64` | Donors pooled: distinct donors per dataset, summed over datasets (a donor in two datasets counts twice) |
| `n_datasets` | `INT64` | Datasets that measured the gene and contribute cells |
| `mean_log1p_cp10k` | `FLOAT64` | PRIMARY: cell-level mean of log1p(CP10k), zeros included |
| `frac_expressing` | `FLOAT64` | PRIMARY: fraction of cells with nonzero counts |
| `donor_pseudobulk_mean_cp10k` | `FLOAT64` | SECONDARY, does not rank: donor-pseudobulk mean CP10k (linear scale); NULL when fewer than the release's min_pseudobulk_donors (default 3) donors have a nonzero library |
| `donor_pseudobulk_n_donors` | `INT64` | SECONDARY: donors behind donor_pseudobulk_mean_cp10k |
| `tau` | `FLOAT64` | Tissue-specificity index (0 = ubiquitous, 1 = one cell type) over the gene's cell-type profile; the same on every row of the gene; NULL when fewer than 2 cell types pass or the gene has no expression |

## Worked examples

Queries that run against cellxgene_summary_v as written.

### Which cell types express a gene most, across all normal tissues

```sql
SELECT cell_type_rollup, tissue_general, mean_log1p_cp10k, frac_expressing,
       n_cells, n_donors, n_datasets
FROM cellxgene_summary_v WHERE chr = 11 AND gene_name = 'CD3E' ORDER BY mean_log1p_cp10k DESC LIMIT 20
```
